MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 4 = 12. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 9
   C. 8
   D. 12

2. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 15
   D. 17

3. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 36
   D. 24

4. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 0
   C. 16
   D. 17

5. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 156

6. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 81

7. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 18 cm³
   D. 9 cm³

8. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 1
   C. 15
   D. 56

9. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 10
   D. 25

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 50
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 7

11. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

12. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 24
   C. 10
   D. 25

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
